summary: Innovative Industrial Properties filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an offering of new Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock with a $25.00 per-share liquidation preference, ranking pari passu with its 9.00% Series A preferred and senior to common. Dividend rate, share count and pricing are blank in the preliminary filing. Dividends are payable quarterly from January 15, 2027; the issue is non-callable before 2031 except for REIT or Change-of-Control provisions, with a 9.8% ownership restriction. This is an ordinary preferred shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing and use of proceeds.
